It promotes Open Access to the knowledge generated by the University. Webometrics is providing reliable, multidimensional, updated and useful information about the university’s global performance, taking into account its activities and outputs and their relevance and impact. It promotes academic web presence, supporting the Open Access initiatives for increasing significantly the transfer of scientific and cultural knowledge generated by the universities to the whole Society. It intends to motivate both institutions and scholars to have a web presence that reflects accurately their activities. If the web performance of an institution is below the expected position according to their academic excellence, university authorities should reconsider their web policy, promoting substantial increases in the volume and quality of their electronic publications. Webometrics also measures other missions like teaching, using link analysis for quality evaluation as it is a far more powerful tool than citation analysis or global surveys. Candidate students should use additional criteria if they are trying to choose a university. 2026 التاريخ & المعالم الخدمات المقدمة للدول العربية قصص النجاح الإشــادات رئاسة الأكاديمية التنمية المستدامة بالأكاديمية النقل البحري القبول والتسجيل إلتحق الأن موقع القبول والتسجيل القبول للبكالوريوس القبول للدراسات العليا البرامج الدولية الرسوم الدراسية المنح الدراسية و التخفيضات التقديم عبر الإنترنت الدراسات الأكاديمية الكليات ابحث عن برنامجك شئون التعليم والطلاب السنة التأسيسية دراسات البكالوريوس الدراسات العليا مدرسة الاكاديمية برامج التبادل الطلابي مكتبات الأكاديمية للموارد الرقمية عبر الأنترنت طلبة الأكاديمية الحياة بالأكاديمية شؤون الطلاب الإسكندرية القرية الذكية العلمين مصر الجديدة الطلاب المحتملين طلبة الأكاديمية التقديم عبر الإنترنت البحث العلمي التدريب والخدمة المجتمعية شئون التدريب وخدمة المجتمع نحن نؤمن بأن التميز المستدام في التعليم والبحث ، التطوير والابتكار هما طريقتنا في الوصول إلى الريادة بين الجامعات والمؤسسات التعليمية في المنطقة العربية عالم. الدورات التدريبية الإدارة المركزية لخدمات التدريب والاستشارات التدريب العملي التدريب العملي التدريب الدولي التدريب المحلي خدمة المجتمع والتعليم المستمر الإسكندرية القاهرة بورسعيد الإستشارات معهد الإنتاجية والجودة مع التحديات الاقتصادية وجودة النمو الاقتصادي المستدام أصبحت حاجة ملحة الإسكندرية القاهرة مركز البحوث والاستشارات لقطاع النقل البحري تأسس مركز البحوث والاستشارات بالأكاديمية لخدمة النقل البحري في مصر والدول العربية. المعهد الاقليمى للأمن البحرى RMSI تم إنشاءه بالأكاديمية لتنفيذ متطلبات المعايير الدولية مجمع المنظمة البحرية الدولية خدمات استشارية من خلال المركز العربي الاستشاري للتحقيق في الحوادث البحرية - الأكاديمية. استخدام أي جهاز أو برمجية للتدخل في الوظائف العادية للموقع أو محاولة اعتراض التشغيل الصحيح للموقع. المشاركة في أي نشاط أو اتخاذ أي إجراء من شأنه فرض حمولة مفرطة أو غير متناسبة مع البنية التحتية للموقع. توفير أو تحميل ملفات على هذا الموقع تحتوي على فيروسات أو بيانات تالفة. توفير أو تحميل ملفات تحتوي على برمجيات أو مواد أو بيانات أو معلومات أخرى ليست مملوكة للمستخدم، أو لا يملك ترخيصاً بشأنها. نشر أو إعلان أو توزيع أو تعميم مواد أو معلومات تحوي تشويهاً للسمعة، أو انتهاكاً للقوانين، أو مواد إباحية أو بذيئة، أو مخالفة للتعاليم الإسلامية أو للآداب العامة، أو أية مواد أو معلومات غير قانونية من خلال موقع الأكاديمية. الإعلان على موقع الأكاديمية عن أي منتج أو خدمة تجعل الموقع في وضع انتهاك لأي قانون أو نظام مطبق في أي مجال. إستخدام أو إعادة إستخدام إسم وشعار الأكاديمية العربية للعلوم والتكنولوجيا والنقل البحري والمملوكين لها والمسبغ عليهم الحماية القانونية وفقاً للقرارات الصادرة من مجلس جامعة الدول العربية بحماية إسم وشعار جامعة الدول العربية والمنظمات التابعة لها وكذا القوانين المنظمة لذلك بجمهورية مصر العربية (دولة المقر الرئيسي للأكاديمية) كما يضمن المستخدم بأن نسخ أي محتوى من موقع الأكاديمية عن طريق الأجهزة الالكترونية أو يدويا دون تصريح مسبق مناستخدام محتوى الموقع يكون لأغراض شخصية، ومعلوماتية، وغير تجارية. المعلومات التي يدلي بها عن نفسه عبر الموقع الالكتروني الخاص بالأكاديمية هي معلومات دقيقة وكاملة ومحدثة، امتثالاً لجميع القوانين السارية فيما يتعلق باستخدام الموقع. يجب الامتثال لجميع القوانين السارية فيما يتعلق باستخدامك لموقع الأكاديمية. سياسة الخصوصية تحترم الأكاديمية العربية للعلوم و التكنولوجيا و النقل البحري خصوصية زوارموقعنا الإلكتروني (www.aast.edu) وأمن أية معلومات شخصية قد يقدموها. كما نؤمن بحق الزائر

It promotes Open Access to the knowledge generated by the University. Webometrics is providing reliable, multidimensional, updated and useful information about the university’s global performance, taking into account its activities and outputs and their relevance and impact. It promotes academic web presence, supporting the Open Access initiatives for increasing significantly the transfer of scientific and cultural knowledge generated by the universities to the whole Society. It intends to motivate both institutions and scholars to have a web presence that reflects accurately their activities. If the web performance of an institution is below the expected position according to their academic excellence, university authorities should reconsider their web policy, promoting substantial increases in the volume and quality of their electronic publications. Webometrics also measures other missions like teaching, using link analysis for quality evaluation as it is a far more powerful tool than citation analysis or global surveys. Candidate students should use additional criteria if they are trying to choose a university. Webometrics ranking correlates well with the quality of education provided and academic prestige. About South Valley Campus

Arab Academy for Science, Technology & Maritime Transport

The Arab Academy for Science, Technology, and Maritime Transport (AASTMT) is a member organization of the League of Arab States. It has the mandate to provide educational, vocational, and consultancy services to the communities of member nations of the League.
In 2005, the Governorate of Aswan invited AASTMT to initiate a campus in the city. The purpose of the campus is to catalyze the development of the South Valley region, which comprises Aswan, Luxor, Qena, Sohag, Asyut, Minya, the Red Sea, and the New Valley. Accordingly, the city designated to AASTMT the dormitories of the Hotel School as a temporary campus in addition to a neighboring 3,250 sqm land for the construction of the permanent campus. Instructions started for the first time on the South Valley campus in October 2006.

Welcome to AASTMT College of International Transport and Logistics in Dokki, where your future in global trade and logistics begins! Our vibrant community offers you a world-class education, blending innovative teaching with practical experience in one of the most dynamic fields today.

College of International Transport and Logistics, Lataki

The College of International Transport and Logistics (CITL) in Latakia, Syria, was established at the AASTMT Latakia branch in 2008.
the College of International Transport and Logistics in Latakia serves as a key educational hub in Syria, providing specialized training and qualifications in the vital field of logistics and global trade, under the umbrella of the well-regarded Arab Academy for Science, Technology & Maritime Transport.

The program aims to produce competent graduates who can handle modern trends in the global economy, understand the globalization of production and investment, and work in various sectors such as internal and external trade, industry, banking, insurance, oil companies, and all types of transport companies (land, sea, air), ports, warehouses, container companies, and shipping agencies.

It is well known that the degree of the development of a nation is measured by the capital consumption of electrical energy. The generation of electricity, it's transmission, distribution, and utilization are thus the primary concern to all developing and rapidly industrializing countries. With electrification of conventional and renewable energy projects forging ahead in developing countries and peak demand forecast doubling every ten years. Arab and African countries are currently studying projects for the formation of super grids linking all nations from Iraq in the east to Morocco in the west, and from North Africa across the continent to South Africa Read more Student activities The department offers a number of activities and trips to student in tandem with educational duties Clubs & Organizations Provide support to all students, as well as countless opportunities to make new friends Sports Activities Great sports facilities are available, whatever your sport is. They work on renewable energy systems such as solar and wind power. Also they may be involved in research and development of new technologies such as Microgrids that improve the efficiency and sustainability of power system. Electric Mobility Electric Mobility Engineer designs and develops electric vehicles and related technologies. They are responsible for creating efficient and sustainable transportation systems that use electric power train technologies, in-vehicle information, and communication technologies. They also work on improving battery technology, charging infrastructure, and energy management systems. Love Cars ? Your Career path in Electric Vehicles industry can start with Electrical and Control Engineering Degree Lets get ready to work with automated control systems such as robots and unmanned systems. The Construction and Building Engineering programs at Arab Academy for Science, Technology and Maritime Transport are one of the most creative and pioneer programs in the region. Our undergraduate programs provides the necessary technical skills in mathematics, basic science, engineering sciences, and social sciences consistent with accreditation standards and national needs. The program is to provide students and the construction industry with the highest level of technical preperation, professional developement and leadership skills for successful careers in Construction Engineering and excellence in higher education by providing high-quality education based on a well balanced curriculum. The department provides a graduate program which offers either a Diploma or Master of Science in Construction and Building Engineering. Our faculties research experties includes sturctures, environmental, geotechnical, materials, water resources, construction management, transportation, and construction engineering. Welcome to College of Maritime Transport and Technology
Welcome to College of Maritime Transport and Technology

The College of Maritime Transport and Technology is considered one of the specialized colleges of the Arab Academy for Science, Technology and Maritime Transport which awards specialized certificates in the field of Maritime Transport.  Throughout its glorious history of more than twenty years, this College has been a pioneering college in the field of maritime education and training, which culminated in its obtaining Quality Certificate ISO 9001 in September 1994.  No wonder, the countries of the European Union (EU) and the countries which have achieved an advanced status in the Maritime Field recognized the Certificates of Competency (COC)  accredited by the Egyptian Authority for Maritime Safety.

MBA Master of Business Administration A Master of Business Administration (MBA) is an advanced academic qualification that equips individuals with both theoretical knowledge and practical skills relevant to business and investment management. The program aims to enhance graduates' comprehension of various aspects of general business management, enabling them to pursue prosperous and fulfilling careers in professional management while also serving as a source of inspiration for future global business leaders. DBA Doctorate of Business Administration The Doctorate of Business Administration (DBA) is designed for students who wish to pursue a professional career. The DBA is focused on both theory and applied research and will help the students to acquire leadership skills as an executive, consultant, or entrepreneur. BDC Business Development Center The Business Development Center (BDC) is an essential entity that plays a pivotal role in fostering the progress and advancement of businesses. The DBC offers invaluable aid by providing solutions to various challenges, enabling businesses to gain access to capital, foster the exchange of innovative technologies, and enhance their overall business. DBA/PhD International Programs The DBA/PhD focuses mainly on the application of theoretical knowledge to the advancement of management and business practices. It is internationally recognized as the most appropriate post-MBA program as it combines academic research and business practices to further the development of personal and professional skills. The test was developed by Cambridge English Language Assessment, which has a long history of language assessment & close links to the development of the CEFR. The test covers Reading, Use of English and Listening.A report of the results is provided from CEFR Level Pre-A1–C2. Instructions for Cambridge Placement Test Test Preparations How is the CPT scored? The CBPT is automatically scored. The examinee knows the score directly after finishing the exam. The score is recorded and automatically documented by the computer system and the administrators of the exam. How long does it take? The test takes approximately 30 minutes. The test will not end abruptly but will allow the candidate to complete the task they are answering. The test ends when the candidate clicks on the arrow to go to the next task. When and where can I register? Registration for the exam starts in April and ends in September. Students should contact the students’ admission and registration in order to pay the required booking fees and schedule a timing. Instructions for Students DEMO test 1. GO to https://www.metritests.com/metricatestdelivery/Assessment/Assignment?test=cept_demo 2.Choose " Play sound " to test your headphone 3. Press 4. Press "Start" 5. Repeat steps 3 & 4 if needed What is an adaptive test? As the candidate progresses through the test, each item is chosen on the basis of the candidate response to the previous item. Under the Patronage and Honor of

H.E. Mr. Ahmed Aboul Gheit

Secretary-General of the Arab League


We are honored to invite you to attend

Arab Dialogue Circle on
"Artificial Intelligence in the Arab World"

At Headquarters of the General Secretariat of the Arab League States in Cairo

February 2-3, 2025

Jointly Organized by

The Arab Academy for Science Technology, and Maritime Transport
and
Naif Arab University for Security Sciences

Final Statement of the Arab Dialogue Circle on Artificial Intelligence in the Arab World:
" Innovative Applications and Ethical Challenges"

Under the patronage and presidency of His Excellency Mr. Ahmed Aboul Gheit, Secretary-General of the League of Arab States and Chairman of the Higher Coordination Committee for Joint Arab Action, and through the joint organization of the Arab Academy for Science, Technology, and Maritime Transport (AASTMT), headed by H.E. Prof. Dr. Ismail Abdel Ghafar, and Naif Arab University for Security Sciences (NAUSS), headed by H.E. Dr. Abdulmajeed Al-Banyan, in cooperation with the General Secretariat of the League of Arab States, the Arab Dialogue Forum on Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the Arab World: “Innovative Applications and Ethical Challenges,” was held over two days (2-3 February 2025) at the headquarters of the League of Arab States.


The event was attended by H.E. Prof. Dr. Amr Talaat, Egyptian Minister of Communications and Information Technology and Chairman of the current session of the Arab Council of Ministers of Communications and Information and its Executive Bureau, along with H.E. Mr. Mohammed Al-Yamahi, President of the Arab Parliament, esteemed permanent representatives, and officials from Arab member states, as well as a distinguished group of international and Arab specialists in AI, senior officials from Arab ministries of communications and information, and representatives of Arab organizations and unions concerned with AI applications.


Event Importance and Objectives

The convening of this forum was in implementation of the Economic and Social Council Resolution No. 2444, in its regular session (114) in September 2024, which approved the decisions of the regular session (56) of the Higher Coordination Committee for Joint Arab Action in April 2024, and the decisions of the (28th) session of the Arab Council of Ministers of Communications and Information in January 2024.

The objectives included:
  • • Exploring the latest global innovations in AI and promoting their adoption in the Arab world.
  • • Discussing the ethical and legislative challenges facing the employment of AI across various sectors.
  • • Developing a unified Arab vision for leveraging AI in a balanced way that ensures technological progress while preserving Arab values and culture.
  • • Enhancing Arab cooperation in AI to support sustainable development in the region.

Dialogue Sessions

The forum featured four main discussion panels:
  • 1. Panel 1: Modern Innovations in Artificial Intelligence: Exploring Global Trends and Applications in the Arab Region, with a focus on generative AI, drones, and robotics. This session was chaired by Prof. Dr. Ali Fahmy, Dean of the AI College at AASTMT.
  • 2. Panel 2: AI for Diplomacy and Peacekeeping: Prospects for International Cooperation and Conflict Prevention, chaired by H.E. Ambassador Hossam Zaki, Assistant Secretary-General and Head of the Secretary-General’s Office.
  • 3. Panel 3: Ethics of AI Usage: Focusing on the Importance of Ethical and Legislative Frameworks for AI Applications in the Arab World, chaired by H.E. Dr. Abdulmajeed Al-Banyan, President of NAUSS.
  • 4. Panel 4: Technical Session to Discuss Implementation Mechanisms of the Main Panels, chaired by H.E. Prof. Dr. Ismail Abdel Ghafar, President of AASTMT.

Key Recommendations

Based on the rich discussions, the participants arrived at several strategic recommendations supporting joint Arab action in AI, including:
  • 1. Launching a unified Arab initiative to foster innovation in AI, ensuring these innovations align with authentic Arab values.
  • 2. Proposing a common Arab legislative framework to regulate AI usage, balancing technological advancement with privacy and cybersecurity protection.
  • 3. Strengthening Arab and international cooperation by establishing specialized Arab platforms for exchanging expertise and knowledge in AI applications, with a focus on partnerships with leading international organizations.
  • 4. Prioritizing AI in national development plans of Arab states and promoting its role in fields such as education, healthcare, security, and digital infrastructure.
  • 5. Developing an Arab Charter on AI Ethics to define the ethical principles for using AI across various sectors, considering the cultural, religious, and legal dimensions of Arab countries.
  • 6. Establishing specialized research centers within Arab academic institutions, particularly supporting the Arab AI Center hosted by AASTMT in its Alamein branch in Egypt, under the League of Arab States framework, to study AI’s societal impact and promote research in this field.
  • 7. Launching specialized Arab training and capacity-building programs in AI targeting government employees, startups, and innovators to develop national competencies in this field.

Organizing Committee

The Higher Organizing Committee was chaired by H.E. Dr. Ali bin Ibrahim Al-Maliki, Assistant Secretary-General and Head of the Economic Affairs Sector at the League of Arab States, with the following members:
  • • Prof. Dr. Ali Fahmy, Dean of the AI College at AASTMT and Chairman of the Scientific Committee for the Dialogue Forum
  • • Minister Plenipotentiary Dr. Raed Al-Jubouri, Director of the Department of Arab Organizations and Unions
  • • Dr. Mostafa Rasheed, Assistant President of AASTMT for Arab Affairs and General Coordinator of the Forum
  • • Dr. Khalid Al-Harfash, Vice President of NAUSS for External Relations
  • • Minister Plenipotentiary Dr. Khalid Wali, Director of the Communication and IT Development Department at the League of Arab States
  • • Dr. Maryam Ammi, Director of the Partnerships and International Cooperation Department at NAUSS
  • • Engineer Soha Othman, Head of the AI Division at the Communication and IT Development Department
  • • Dr. Basma Abdullah, Head of the Technical Follow-up Unit at the AASTMT President’s Office and Secretary of the Committee

Closing Session

In the closing session chaired by H.E. Ahmed Aboul Gheit, it was agreed to include these recommendations in a historical document currently being prepared, which will outline actionable strategies. The document will be submitted to the (57th) session of the Higher Coordination Committee for Joint Arab Action, chaired by the Secretary-General of the League of Arab States, scheduled to be held in Tunisia from 13 to 15 April 2025, and to the upcoming session of the Arab Council of Ministers of Communications and Information and its Executive Bureau.

The forum emphasized the continuation of dialogue and cooperation between Arab states and specialized Arab organizations to ensure optimal utilization of AI for sustainable development, digital security enhancement, and the preservation of Arab cultural identity.

The Dialogue Circle’s Vision

To position the Arab region as a global leader in harnessing artificial intelligence while preserving its rich cultural identity and values.

The Dialogue Circle will aim to create a historical document that advocates for the preservation of Arab identity amidst rapid technological advancements.

This document will propose essential legislation and frameworks to regulate AI usage in alignment with authentic Arab values, ensuring that innovation respects and enriches cultural heritage

Theme of the Arab Dialogue Circle

Amid the rapid technological advancements and major digital transformations, the world is witnessing today, artificial intelligence (AI) applications have become central across various fields.
These applications are not merely tools for improving efficiency and productivity but also represent a new future filled with immense opportunities and challenges.
It is essential to delve deeply into this topic in the Arab region, which is striving to keep pace with these developments and maximize their benefits.

In this context, the initiative to hold an Arab Dialogue Circle on the latest trends in AI applications, their ethics, and their impact on the Arab region emerges.
This circle brings together a distinguished group of experts and specialists in AI to explore and discuss the latest developments and applications, exchange ideas on the ethical challenges associated with AI usage, and examine the impact of these technologies on society and the economy in the Arab world.

This dialogue circle will provide a unique platform for constructive interaction and knowledge exchange, aiming to shape shared visions and future strategies that promote innovation and achieve sustainable development in the Arab region.
We look forward to a fruitful and constructive dialogue that contributes to directing efforts toward a prosperous future, enhancing the Arab region's position in the global AI landscape.

RMSI has experienced Maritime Security Experts to execute the following: - Develop the security plans for ships and ports/port facilities according to the requirements of international codes, conventions, national legislations, and companies' policies. - Conduct the security exercises, drills, and audits onboard ships and within ports/port facilities in accordance with STCW 78, as amended in 2017, and the ISPS Code. - Conduct the IMO Validated courses in the field of Maritime Security according to STCW 1978, Manilla's amendments 2010, and ISPS Code. - Conduct other tailored maritime security programs, courses, and workshops to meet the special requirements for seafarers and ports/port facilities personnel. (hybrid system) Promoting the Minds & Talents More Establishment - The RMSI was established in September 2003 at AASTMT to implement international requirements of the maritime security, ISPS Code, and relevant agreements and codes. - The RMSI has been approved and accredited as a recognized security organization (RSO) by the Egyptian Maritime Transport and Logistics Sector under Decree No. 15 of 2004, and by the Egyptian Authority for Maritime Safety. RMSI is also recognized in several other Arab and African countries for its role in implementing maritime security standards and ISPS Code. - The RMSI has been certified by (ISO 9001:2015) from the certification body DNV. Oil and Gas Hub

Arab Academy for Science, Technology and Maritime

Oil and Gas Hub

Arab Academy for Science, Technology and Maritime

Oil and Gas Hub

Welcome

Oil and Gas Hub

Oil and gas hub is created by ASSTMT to support oil, gas and energy industries locally and regionally.

The hub provides a variety for B.Sc. Programs in oil and gas engineering, chemical and petrochemical engineering, petroleum and energy logistics. Moreover, MBA and DBA in oil and gas, Master in quality management are also provided. Professional training courses, OPITO approved, for safety (MEMIMR, OIM, BOSEIT…etc.) and work force development are also available. Specialized training using simulators for oil pollution as well as offshore vessels’ dynamic positions did exist.

Throughout his career life, he has occupied several positions where he graduated with an honoured Bachelor degree of Electrical Engineering (Computer Department) from the Military Technical College (MTC) in 1978 then received a master's degree in 1982 from Cairo university starting his career as an assistant lecturer at the Computer Department of the Military Technical College (MTC) then he received the Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering in 1989 from George Washington University, USA and specialized in Computer Engineering starting his career in the Military Technical College (MTC) from 1989 till now as a member of the teaching staff at the Computer Department, where all the positions were held in the Military Technical College. In 1992, His job progression allowed him to be the Head of the Planning Educational Affairs department then the Head of the Advanced Technologies Group in 1997. As in 2001, he was appointed to be the Head of the Planning department of Research Affairs then the Head of Chair of Electrical Engineering branch in 2003. In 2005, he became the Vice Dean for the Post Graduates & Research, then the Vice Dean for Educational Affairs in 2006 who is Responsible for MTC educational Plan. For his scientific and professional efficiency, In January 2007 he became MTC vice Dean for two years, then MTC Commandant, Dean in January 2009 until he was selected to be the president of the Arab Academy for Science, Technology and Maritime Transport (AASTMT). The project will cover the major topics essential for energy transition towards more sustainability including renewable energy resources, energy systems integration, and energy technologies. In addition to the core energy knowledge, students will be equipped with an essential toolkit of applied informatics and energy data analytics to manage real-life energy projects and therefore making them ready for a variety of careers in the energy industry. Thus, the project will enable the students to tackle complex energy and climate challenges by developing and implementing technological concepts and solutions, understanding the energy business environment, and analysing available energy-related data through the use of artificial intelligent techniques and machine learning skills in their countries. In addition the project is designed to positively impact and support gender equality in the energy sector workforce in the academia/private sector. Through skill development, resource provision and networking opportunities the project seeks to equip women in STEM with the tools to overcome barriers and excel in their careers. Empower HER is designed to address critical challenges while driving innovation and economic growth. By expanding the talent pool in STEM the project stimulates technological advancement and enhances Egypts global competitiveness. A significant focus is placed on narrowing the gender income gap and improving financial stability for women contributing to economic development attracting investment and strengthening domestic industries. The project also emphasizes community development by extending its activities to underprivileged areas through STEM education programs reducing poverty and improving social welfare. Empower HER aims to enhance research and development in critical sectors like healthcare agriculture, and renewable energy, benefiting Egyptian citizens and boosting quality of life. Internationally Empower HER fosters cross cultural collaboration between the University of Central Lancashire UC Lan UK and the Arab Academy for Science Technology and Maritime Transport AASTMT Egypt. This partnership promotes global understanding empowers women professionals and drives innovative solutions to global challenges. By supporting women graduates in STEM the project contributes to a diverse and skilled workforce enhancing creativity problem solving and competitiveness across industries. Empower HER represents a transformative step toward gender equality innovation and community development with its success contingent on effective implementation and the collective support of government academia and the private sector https://aast.edu/en/sdg/empowerher/index.php Project Name Empower HER Advancing Women in STEM Education & Careers Ref No/ Funded Entity GEP 2023-48 Project Duration 16month Project Start Date 2023-12-01 Project End Date 2025-03-01 Total Budget EUR Budget of the academy in this project EUR Project Website Go to Website Objectives Address gender inequality in STEM fields Promote innovation and technological advancement Enhance financial stability of women and help narrow the gender income gap Our Partners University of Central Lancashire, UK https://www.uclan.ac.uk/ Yasser Gaber Dessouky Dean of Scientific Research and Innovation Mobile: 01006030790 E-mail: ygd@aast.edu Project Coordinator Yasser Gaber Dessouky Dean of Scientific Research and Innovation Mobile: 01006030790 E-mail: ygd@aast.edu This Project is Funded by British council Explore The Academy About AASTMT Maritime Admission Campuses Student Affairs Services Academics Education Colleges Arab Academy International Study Center Deaneries Institutes Centers Complexes Certificates Verification Get In Touch Contact Us Maps and Locations Virtual Tour Jobs and Vacancies Stay Connected © 2025 | All Right Reserved IDC - AASTMT Policies & Terms of Use Copyright Sitemap

As part of this recovery process, using means of virtual communication and sharing information was a strong shift that is already in action by many industries. Using formats of extended reality in teaching, communicating, and project execution provides an inclusive dimension that will be able to provide opportunities for personal socio-educational and professional development of academics, students, and the community of the universities in this consortium. Starting 2022 with the vast AI application and chatbots being available for everyone to try, design, and produce it became more essential for young entrepreneurs and marketers to profoundly navigate the digital world of design and product delivery. Adding to this the META market and its immersive environment and market, it is non-negotiable that XR and digitizing products using XR mediums is a must-have skill for our students. Using formats of extended reality in developing digital skills and competences and skills in forward-looking fields will provide a strong contribution in motivating innovation and bridging the knowledge skills and capabilities gap that is found between graduates capabilities and business capacities in the MENA partners against the knowledge and competences of the market in Europe. As businesses need to become more competitive through talent and innovation this investment benefits individuals, institutions, organizations and society as a whole to find sustainable growth and richness. The GreenMED's ambition is to contribute directly and actively to the emission targets established by the EU under the 2030 and 2050 milestones. However, the goals' realisation relies on the comprehension and integration of innovative technologies, specifically selected depending on future potentials and various economic, social and environmental criteria. Thus, to perform this task, the regional ship energy demands, the fuel supply chains in both shores of the Mediterranean Sea, and the variety of emerging green shipping technologies will be considered. The assessment of these aspects will lead to the establishment of a decarbonization hub, the Mediterranean Sustainable Shipping Observatory (MSSO)which will serve the Project Name EUROPEAN CLIMATE, INFRASTRUCTURE AND ENVIRONMENT EXECUTIVE AGENCY (CINEA) Ref No/ Funded Entity 101124925 Project Duration 24month Project Start Date 2023-10-01 Project End Date 2025-09-30 Total Budget EUR Budget of the academy in this project EUR Project Website Go to Website Objectives project's objectives through the development of a stakeholders network and the building of knowledge capacity. Τhe Green MED project will elaborate on existing studies of maritime alternative fuels and green shipping technologies to attain the energy consumption of the maritime transportation chain in the Mediterranean, a process which will be combined with the full mapping of the fuel supply chain. The outcomes of Green MED will map the decarbonization pathways and options. These will be available to stakeholders as recommendations for policy making and informed investment decisions, while simultaneously facilitating a clean energy transition in the Mediterranean region, towards achieving the targets of climate neutrality. That is why numerical modelling is steadily gaining ground in a range of STEM related fields. Numerical modelling allows for quick and inexpensive testing without needing to build physical devices, gives insight and understanding into different phenomena, can be used to design products/solutions and can be used to optimize processes. Furthermore, in order to create real world solutions and to transform the education, the technical training needs to be coupled with business training. PYTHAGORAS addresses those needs and will provide a total of 8 educational modules (physical and online) covering topics from numerical modelling and design to entrepreneurship and business skills. Those modules can stand alone and can be used to update and modernize existing curricula. The education will be applied for solving real life problems with (3 expected) case studies specified from Egypt and Tunisia and with the students presenting a business case on the solutions they developed. The training will be for the next generation of innovators: University graduate and undergraduate students and professionals (target is over 200) and for professors who will be shaping the next generation of students (target 20). The activities also include setting up of interconnected labs and engaging the labour market. The impact will be on increase of the skill set of the participants, improvement of employment prospects, development of an engineering innovation culture where modernized knowledge (based on advanced numerical and digital methods) is applied and taken to the market. The Centre will train Postgraduate (PG) and Undergraduate (UG) students on Hybrid Electric Vehicle methodologies and technologies for the different final users (in industries, and in transport) and will develop code of practice for the Efficient use of Energy in the Hybrid Electric Vehicle a joint collaboration between EU and Mediterranean Universities. The former will transfer EU best practices, experiences and methodologies according to the Bologna process to support the development and diffusion of an innovative experience in technical higher education in Mediterranean institutions supporting the capacity and knowledge building in Hybrid Electric Vehicle Technologies. The realization of Hybrid Electric Vehicle center will follow a scenario assessment taking into account of Mediterranean institutions sector needs and requirements, and EU best practices developed. The SPEED project aims at establishing new modules on Hybrid Electric Vehicle and Rational Use of Energy based an innovative approach that includes the respect of both European and Extra European quality standards, the promotion of students and professor's mobility, the internationalization of education and training and the use of digital technologies in learning. SPEED project will train new PG and UG with an advanced level of education for the exercise of a highly qualified activity in Hybrid Electric Vehicle Technologies. In the Mediterranean Area, the development of the Hybrid Electric Vehicle infrastructures is a key factor for the environmental protection and the socioeconomic development. High efficient Hybrid Electric Vehicle save resources and supports the energy roadmap 2050 economic case for decarbonization and serves meeting the 80-85% GHG reduction target by 2050, while promoting renewable, clean energy. The project will help in providing qualified professional resources capable of sustaining and managing the huge effort of Hybrid Electric Vehicle infrastructure development. Special emphasis will be given to advanced energy management. The project will be oriented to further development of the process of interaction with professional communities and reflects their requirements in the developed curriculum. SPEED proposal will include the Training of Trainers activity (PC) that will be carried out by workshops and webinars. EU professors will share competences with the Partner Countries professors, supporting them in the elaboration of the teaching material (in English language – Official EU language). Teaching material will consist of slides, supplementary notes, case studies, exercises, and supporting material (e.g., videos, standards, guidelines, papers, technical documents). Learning outcome approach will be used. No Poverty SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT GOAL 1 End poverty in all its forms everywhere SDG1 Report (2022/ 2023) In line with Sustainable Development Goal 1 (SDG1) to eradicate global poverty, the Arab Academy for Science, Technology, and Maritime Transport (AASTMT) has implemented a comprehensive approach. AASTMT is committed to increasing financial aid for students, developing anti-poverty programs, and engaging in community initiatives. The institution provides financial support, ranging from 10% to 15%, to new students each semester, with consideration for individual financial challenges. Charitable organizations contribute scholarships, fostering an environment for education. AASTMT extends its commitment to SDG1 by offering training courses, supporting entrepreneurship through the AAST Entrepreneurship Center, operating regionally, and engaging in social responsibility activities globally. The institution aims to create a lasting impact on individuals and communities in alignment with SDG1. Quality Education SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT GOAL 4 SDG4 Report (2022/2023) In pursuit of Sustainable Development Goal 4 (SDG4) and a commitment to fostering accessible, quality education, the Arab Academy for Science, Technology, and Maritime Transport (AASTMT) has made remarkable strides across various dimensions of educational development. AASTMT stands out in providing qualifications for primary school teaching, ensuring its graduates are equipped to meet the rigorous standards required at this foundational level. The institution's dedication to lifelong learning is evident through a comprehensive framework that encompasses diverse measures, from the provision of free access to educational resources like computers, libraries, online courses, and lectures, to offering free courses leading to certificates or awards. AASTMT's commitment extends beyond traditional academic boundaries, with free access to campus facilities and equipment, making education a community-wide endeavor. The institution actively engages in hosting public events and vocational training opportunities open to the public, including executive education programs, thereby contributing to the dissemination of knowledge. Furthermore, AASTMT has embraced an education outreach ethos, conducting tailored lectures and demonstrations in local schools and communities. The institution's adherence to an inclusive lifelong learning access policy ensures that educational opportunities are available to all, irrespective of ethnicity, religion, disability, immigration status, or gender. Additionally, AASTMT's commitment to tracking and increasing student enrollment metrics, particularly the number of students starting degree programs and the inclusion of first-generation students, underscores its dedication to advancing education and inclusivity. In essence, AASTMT's comprehensive approach to SDG4 criteria not only enriches its immediate community but also sets a commendable standard for fostering a future where education is a continual pursuit accessible to everyone. Clean Water and Sanitation SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT GOAL 6 SDG6 report (2022-2023) The Arab Academy for Science, Technology & Maritime Transport (AASTMT) has significantly contributed to Sustainable Development Goal 6 (SDG6) by fostering initiatives that ensure access to clean water and sanitation. Through innovative research programs, AASTMT has developed advanced technologies for water purification and waste management, directly impacting local communities and industries. Collaborative efforts with stakeholders have led to the implementation of sustainable practices, raising awareness about water conservation and sanitation standards. AASTMT's educational curriculum also emphasizes the importance of water resources, nurturing a generation of professionals committed to addressing the challenges of water scarcity and promoting sustainable water management strategies in the region. Success Stories
We pride ourselves at the Academy on supporting our students to become work-ready graduates by helping them to gain vital experience and acquire and develop the skills they need for their success as they go on to enjoy their chosen careers. They learn these skills during their courses, and the experience through internships or practical training opportunities we provide them. Our graduates leave with practical knowledge, skills, and the competitive edge to be successful in any business.

Students Success

We present you our students success stories to inspire you to create your own opportunities and find your career path

Salem Nabil Abu Bakr

College of Engineering and Technology, Mechanics Department, September 2019

Salem Nabil Abu Bakr graduated from the College of Engineering and Technology, Mechanics Department in September 2019.A journey that lasted for 5 years, which started by joining the Arab Academy for Science, Technology, and Maritime Transport in 2014. After joining the academy, I noticed that it took part in many scientific competitions and activities, such as remotely operated vehicles (ROV), mine detectors, formula, ACM competitions among others. Dr. Gamal Elddin Mokhtar

1928 - 2018

"We belong to God, and to him we will return"

Founder and President of AASTMT

His Excellency Prof. Dr Gamal Mokhtar, the Founder and AASTMT President, one of the most successful Arab joint institutions on the land of Egypt, that was the Arab Academy for Science, Technology and Maritime Transport – one of the League of Arab States specialized Organization stated in 1972.

Dr. Mokhtar played a significant role in changing the Arab Maritime Transport Academy to be a leading university in sciences and technology and in all other disciplines related to maritime transport, engineering and management whether at the academic or the professional levels; in addition of being a unique entity of research and consultation. Especially after attaining ISO 9001 / 2000 from D.N.V, as implementing and developing its Quality Assurance System, it transmitted from the regional to the international status. As AAST-MT is a fully fledged member of the Arab and International Universities Associations.

Read Full Biography

With deep sorrow and agony, H.E Prof. Dr. Ismail Abdel Ghafar Ismail Farag - President of the Arab Academy for Science, Technology and Maritime Transport, expresses his sincere condolences to AASTMT Family on the death of His Excellency Prof. Dr Gamal Mokhtar - AASTMT Founder and President.

AASTMT is regularly recognized in major international systems such as the QS World University Rankings, the Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings, and the THE Impact Rankings, where the Academy consistently achieves top positions nationally and strong placements regionally. It is also ranked in the QS Subject Rankings, particularly in engineering and tecnology fields, underscoring its academic strengths. Within the Arab region, AASTMT is an active participant in the Arab Ranking for Universities (ARU), where it is acknowledged among the region's leading institutions for teaching quality, research activity, and community engagement. These achievements reflect AASTMT's long-term strategy (2024-2027) to enhance research output, foster international collaboration, and build a reputation as a regional hub with growing global influence. title: Arab Academy for Science, Technology & Maritime Transport
raw_text:
2025 Call For Collaboration Research and Innovation Project

To contribute to the aspirations of the Arab Academy for Science, Technology and Maritime Transport (AASTMT) becoming a model national university in the region, recognized for high-quality education, research, training and consultancy, the AASTMT will take a leading role in creating the environment and the tools to foster excellence in research. Because the AASTMT's vision places equal emphasis on teaching and research, it serves researchers by providing full support and effective administrative expertise to the AASTMT's research community. In this spirit, the AASTMT is launching a new call for funding opportunities to assist researchers endeavours to develop projects that serve in their own progress as well as that of the AASTMT and the National and regional States. This call will provide opportunities for researchers at all levels, from students to professionals, in the private, public, and academic sectors. The AASTMT GRANT is one of the activities of Unit of Scientific Research and Innovation and the primary means by which AASTMT will seek to address Research Strategy, and key national needs through research.

 

OBJECTIVES OF THE AASTMT GRANT CALL

The goal of this Call is to create long-term research collaboration between AASTMT researchers and regional research institutions through open competition to achieve the following objects:

 i.    Promote multidisciplinary collaborative R&D projects within AASTMT,

ii.    Support research outputs exploitation and innovation with closer links to regional industries,

iii.    Promote the key issues of competitiveness, collaboration and venture capital investment,

iv.    Support applied research projects that contribute to the achievement of sustainable development,

v.    Raise awareness on importance of R&D and innovation in developing new technologies and their economic and social impacts.

 

RESEARCH AREAS OF INTEREST

  •           Computer Science and ICT

  •           Basic and Fundamental Sciences

  •           Climate Change and Environmental Sciences

  •           Economics and Sustainable Development

  •           Engineering (all disciplines, including Marine and Offshore Engineering)

  •           Medical and Health Sciences

  •           Social Sciences, Arts, and Humanities

  •           Energy

  •           Logistics Sciences

  •           Water Resource Management

  •           Food and Agriculture

  •           Archaeology and Heritage Studies

  •           Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Technologies

  •           Blue Economy and Marine Sciences

  •           Smart Cities and Urban Development

  •           Education and Pedagogical Innovation

  •           Public Policy, Governance, and Law

Renewable Energy and Sustainable Development

Renewable Energy and Sustainable Development (RESD) is a biannual, peer-reviewed international journal that offers a global platform for the dissemination of cutting-edge research, case studies, and reviews focusing on renewable energy and its role in promoting sustainable development. Indexed in SCOPUS since 2021, RESD is committed to advancing knowledge and fostering innovation in the rapidly evolving fields of energy and sustainability.

The journal serves as a crucial resource for researchers, scientists, engineers, policymakers, and institutions worldwide, keeping them informed on the latest theoretical and practical advancements in renewable energy technologies. RESD welcomes experimental, computational, and theoretical studies across a broad spectrum of renewable energy topics, including but not limited to: - Wind energy; - Solar power; - Wave and tidal energy; - Hydropower; - Geothermal energy; - Hydrogen and fuel cells; - Energy from biomass and biofuels; - Energy savings and efficiency.

A focal point of RESD is the integration of renewable energy technologies into electrical power networks and smart grids. The journal also places significant emphasis on sustainable development, a multidisciplinary field that addresses how energy technologies can align with the UN Millennium Development Goals and ongoing efforts to achieve sustainable economic and social growth, particularly in transition economies.

In addition to its focus on innovative research, RESD encourages the submission of case studies that explore the nexus of renewable energy and sustainable development. As an open-access journal, RESD is published under a liberal Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International License, ensuring that authors retain copyright while enabling broad dissemination of their work.

Supported by the Arab Academy for Science, Technology and Maritime Transport (AASTMT), RESD is committed to maintaining high-quality, open-access publications. Starting January 2024, Article Processing Charges (APCs) will be introduced: 10,000 L.E. for Egyptian authors and 100 USD for international authors.

RESD’s esteemed editorial and advisory boards consist of leading scientists and engineers who contribute their vast expertise in renewable energy and sustainability, enriching the journal’s content and its relevance to the global research community.

International Business Logistics

International Business Logistics (IBL) Journal is a biannual international peer-reviewed journal which presents a global forum for dissemination of research articles, case studies and reviews focusing on all aspects of logistics and its role in business development worldwide.

The journal aims to present to the international community important results of work in the fields of logistics and business research to help researchers, scientists, manufacturers, institutions, world agencies, societies to keep up with new developments in theory and applications. Experimental, computational and theoretical studies are all welcomed to IBL.

The topics of focal interest to IBL include, but are not limited to, all aspects of logistics, supply chain management, supply chain resilience, reverse logistics and green supply chain, global supply chain risk management, blockchain, digital transformation in logistics and supply chain, last mile logistics, retailing, modelling of the supply chain and transportation simulations, transport systems and processes, multimodal transport, maritime transport economics, , and sustainable development. In addition, IBL also covers multidisciplinary areas such as supply chain finance, supply chain marketing, cross-functional relationships, human resources management in the field of logistics etc.

 The journal is open-access with a liberal Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International License which preserves the copyrights of published materials to the authors and protects it from unauthorized commercial use.

The IBL journal does not collect Articles Processing Charges (APCs) or submission fees, and is free of charge for authors and readers, and operates an online submission with the peer review system allowing authors to submit articles online and track their progress via its web interface.

The journal is financially supported by the Arab Academy f0or Science, Technology and Maritime Transport AASTMT in order to maintain a quality open-access source of research papers on business logistics and related topics.

IBL has an outstanding editorial and advisory board of eminent scientists, researchers and engineers who contribute and enrich the journal with their vast experience in different fields of interest to the journal.

Advances in Computing and Engineering

Journal of Advances in Computing and Engineering (ACE) is a peer-reviewed, open access, interdisciplinary journal, with two issues yearly. The focus of the journal is on theories, methods, and applications in computing and engineering. The journal covers all areas of computing, engineering, and technology, including interdisciplinary topics. ACE also publishes survey and review articles.

The scope of ACE includes but not limited to the following topics: Computer science theory; Algorithms; Intelligent computing; Bioinformatics; Health informatics; Deep learning; Networks; Wireless communication systems; Signal processing; Robotics; Optical design engineering; Sensors.

All submitted articles should report original, previously unpublished research results, experimental or theoretical. Articles submitted to the journal should meet these criteria and must not be under consideration for publication elsewhere. The manuscript should follow the style specified by the journal. For LaTeX format Submissions, kindly use this template: LaTeX Template for PLOS (Public Library of Science) Articles.

The journal is open-access with a liberal Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International License which preserves the copyrights of published materials to the authors and protects it from unauthorized commercial use.

The ACE journal does not collect Articles Processing Charges (APCs) or submission fees, and is free of charge for authors and readers, and operates an online submission with the peer review system allowing authors to submit articles online and track their progress via its web interface.

The journal is financially supported by the Arab Academy for Science, Technology, and Maritime Transport AASTMT in order to maintain quality open-access source of research papers on Computing and Engineering.

ACE has an outstanding editorial and advisory board of eminent scientists, researchers and engineers who contribute and enrich the journal with their vast experience in different fields of interest to the journal.

Medical and Clinical Research

Apply Now Pioneering Education; Transforming Lives. Encouraging Students to Use Knowledge to Understand and Impact the World. L ER E A D Video credit: Edinboro University Study Locally, Think Globally Empowering students to use their knowledge for meaningful change. Apply Now Study Locally, Think Globally What sets us apart Our History Our Philosophy The University of London (UoL) has a long history and prestigious appeal. The Arab Academy for Science and Technology ( AAST) is UoL’s recognized teaching centre in Cairo. The curriculum of the UoL at AAST is under the direction of the world-renowned London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE), ranked in the top three universities worldwide for social sciences and management. The university provides structured yet flexible guidance to ambitious students who thrive on using knowledge to make the world a better place. Pioneering Education, Transforming Lives. Join the World-Class → LSE Academic Direction → Why UoL at AAST? → Join the World-Class → Embark on an exceptional academic journey with the University of London at AAST Cairo, Egypt. One that will challenge and inspire you to think critically, explore new ideas, and develop innovative solutions to real-world problems. LSE Academic Direction → Our programmes in Economics, Management, Finance, and Social Science (EMFSS) offer globally-recognised BSc degrees that equip you with the skills, ideas, and perspectives needed to make a real impact on the world. With a legacy of producing Nobel Prize laureates, entrepreneurs, academics, and political leaders for almost two centuries, the University of London is renowned for its academic excellence. Why UoL at AAST? → By studying with us, you have the unique opportunity to become a part of this prestigious institution’s world-class alumni network, all while pursuing your degree in Egypt. Explore more Experience World-Class Education with our EMFSS BSc Degrees By studying with us, you can experience an unparalleled education that equips you with the skills, knowledge, and perspectives needed to excel in today’s dynamic business world. BSc in Economics and Management Choosing to pursue a BSc in Economics and Management is an excellent decision for those aspiring to a dynamic and impactful career. This program focuses on the allocation of resources and the impact of economic activity on society, while also delving into effective organisational management. Our coursework covers micro and macro-economics, public policies, monetary economics, international political economy, and an array of finance courses to help you gain the skills necessary to thrive in your career. Learn more BSC Business and Management Our curriculum is tailored for ambitious students who seek practical knowledge beyond theory. Our degree program provides you with the necessary skills to manage a thriving business by gaining insights into organisational culture. With our program, you can explore diverse career paths while preparing for the dynamic business world. Coursework covers an array of topics including marketing management, organisation theory, human resource management, social psychology, and entrepreneurship to equip you with the knowledge and skills needed for a successful career. Learn more BSc in Finance Our BSc programme is specifically crafted to augment your finance, banking, and risk management abilities. By enrolling in this program, you will study core areas of financial institutions and markets, with a focus on the theoretical foundations of banking, finance, and investment management. Coursework will provide in-depth tuition for a wide range of topics including corporate finance, derivatives, financial markets, and security valuation, preparing you for a successful career in the dynamic field of finance. Learn more Previous Next 1st UoL recognised teaching centre in Egypt 20 years of experience 83% 5 consecutive years of excellence ranking in the top 2% of all EMFSS students Achieve academic excellence and unlock your future potential by earning a University of London BSc degree in Egypt! Start Your Application Study Abroad Opportunities Earn a BSc from UoL under LSE’s academic direction while gaining invaluable global experience at your preferred choice from a global network of UoL-recognised teaching centres. Develop critical problem-solving skills, and gain valuable experience in unfamiliar surroundings. These skills and experiences can set you apart in your future career and demonstrate your ability to work independently and adapt to new environments. UoL

L ER E A D Video credit: Edinboro University Study Locally, Think Globally Empowering students to use their knowledge for meaningful change. Apply Now Study Locally, Think Globally What sets us apart Our History Our Philosophy The University of London (UoL) has a long history and prestigious appeal. The Arab Academy for Science and Technology ( AAST) is UoL’s recognized teaching centre in Cairo. The curriculum of the UoL at AAST is under the direction of the world-renowned London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE), ranked in the top three universities worldwide for social sciences and management. The university provides structured yet flexible guidance to ambitious students who thrive on using knowledge to make the world a better place. Pioneering Education, Transforming Lives. Join the World-Class → LSE Academic Direction → Why UoL at AAST? → Join the World-Class → Embark on an exceptional academic journey with the University of London at AAST Cairo, Egypt. One that will challenge and inspire you to think critically, explore new ideas, and develop innovative solutions to real-world problems. LSE Academic Direction → Our programmes in Economics, Management, Finance, and Social Science (EMFSS) offer globally-recognised BSc degrees that equip you with the skills, ideas, and perspectives needed to make a real impact on the world. With a legacy of producing Nobel Prize laureates, entrepreneurs, academics, and political leaders for almost two centuries, the University of London is renowned for its academic excellence. Why UoL at AAST? → By studying with us, you have the unique opportunity to become a part of this prestigious institution’s world-class alumni network, all while pursuing your degree in Egypt. Explore more Experience World-Class Education with our EMFSS BSc Degrees By studying with us, you can experience an unparalleled education that equips you with the skills, knowledge, and perspectives needed to excel in today’s dynamic business world. BSc in Economics and Management Choosing to pursue a BSc in Economics and Management is an excellent decision for those aspiring to a dynamic and impactful career. This program focuses on the allocation of resources and the impact of economic activity on society, while also delving into effective organisational management. Our coursework covers micro and macro-economics, public policies, monetary economics, international political economy, and an array of finance courses to help you gain the skills necessary to thrive in your career. Learn more BSC Business and Management Our curriculum is tailored for ambitious students who seek practical knowledge beyond theory. Our degree program provides you with the necessary skills to manage a thriving business by gaining insights into organisational culture. With our program, you can explore diverse career paths while preparing for the dynamic business world. Coursework covers an array of topics including marketing management, organisation theory, human resource management, social psychology, and entrepreneurship to equip you with the knowledge and skills needed for a successful career. Learn more BSc in Finance Our BSc programme is specifically crafted to augment your finance, banking, and risk management abilities. By enrolling in this program, you will study core areas of financial institutions and markets, with a focus on the theoretical foundations of banking, finance, and investment management. Coursework will provide in-depth tuition for a wide range of topics including corporate finance, derivatives, financial markets, and security valuation, preparing you for a successful career in the dynamic field of finance. Learn more Previous Next 1st UoL recognised teaching centre in Egypt 20 years of experience 83% 5 consecutive years of excellence ranking in the top 2% of all EMFSS students Achieve academic excellence and unlock your future potential by earning a University of London BSc degree in Egypt! Start Your Application Study Abroad Opportunities Earn a BSc from UoL under LSE’s academic direction while gaining invaluable global experience at your preferred choice from a global network of UoL-recognised teaching centres. Develop critical problem-solving skills, and gain valuable experience in unfamiliar surroundings. These skills and experiences can set you apart in your future career and demonstrate your ability to work independently and adapt to new environments. UoL

www.aast.edu والمواقع الفرعية الأخرى (كجزء من النطاق المذكور) وهذا الموقع الألكتروني والمواقع الفرعية التابعة له مملوكة وتدارمن خلال الأكاديمية لتكون نافذة فاعلة للتعرف على أنشطتها وما تقدمه من خدمات للطلبة وأعضاء هيئة التدريس والموظفين فضلاعن الزائريين للموقع. تمثل هذه السياسة جميع الشروط والضوابط التي يجب مراعاتها عند استخدام الموقع الإلكتروني للأكاديمية بحيث تحدد العلاقة بين الموقع من جهة، والمستخدمين أو الزائريين من جهة اخرى مما يضمن تقديم خدمة أفضل وتحقيق أكبراستفادة من كل ما يحتويه الموقع من معلومات. تحتفظ الأكاديمية بحق التعديل لشروط الاستخدام في أي وقت تراه مناسباً. لذا تأكّد من أن تطلع على هذه الصفحة بشكل دوري لتبقى مطلعاً على الإصدار الأحدث لهذه الشروط. ويعتبر استخدامك أو مشاركتك في الموقع بمثابة موافقة مسبقة من جانبك تفيد قانوناً انك قرأت هذه الشروط وتوافق على الالتزام بها. نطاق الاستخدام بدخولك على الموقع الالكتروني الخاص بالأكاديمية فأنت توافق على أنه عند استخدامك للموقع لن تقوم بـ: نسخ أي محتوى من موقع الأكاديمية عن طريق الأجهزة الالكترونية أو يدويا دون تصريح مسبق من الأكاديمية. استخدام أي جهاز أو برمجية للتدخل في الوظائف العادية للموقع أو محاولة اعتراض التشغيل الصحيح للموقع. المشاركة في أي نشاط أو اتخاذ أي إجراء من شأنه فرض حمولة مفرطة أو غير متناسبة مع البنية التحتية للموقع. توفير أو تحميل ملفات على هذا الموقع تحتوي على فيروسات أو بيانات تالفة. توفير أو تحميل ملفات تحتوي على برمجيات أو مواد أو بيانات أو معلومات أخرى ليست مملوكة للمستخدم، أو لا يملك ترخيصاً بشأنها. نشر أو إعلان أو توزيع أو تعميم مواد أو معلومات تحوي تشويهاً للسمعة، أو انتهاكاً للقوانين، أو مواد إباحية أو بذيئة، أو مخالفة للتعاليم الإسلامية أو للآداب العامة، أو أية مواد أو معلومات غير قانونية من خلال موقع الأكاديمية. الإعلان على موقع الأكاديمية عن أي منتج أو خدمة تجعل الموقع في وضع انتهاك لأي قانون أو نظام مطبق في أي مجال. إستخدام أو إعادة إستخدام إسم وشعار الأكاديمية العربية للعلوم والتكنولوجيا والنقل البحري والمملوكين لها والمسبغ عليهم الحماية القانونية وفقاً للقرارات الصادرة من مجلس جامعة الدول العربية بحماية إسم وشعار جامعة الدول العربية والمنظمات التابعة لها وكذا القوانين المنظمة لذلك بجمهورية مصر العربية (دولة المقر الرئيسي للأكاديمية) كما يضمن المستخدم بأن نسخ أي محتوى من موقع الأكاديمية عن طريق الأجهزة الالكترونية أو يدويا دون تصريح مسبق مناستخدام محتوى الموقع يكون لأغراض شخصية، ومعلوماتية، وغير تجارية. المعلومات التي يدلي بها عن نفسه عبر الموقع الالكتروني الخاص بالأكاديمية هي معلومات دقيقة وكاملة ومحدثة، امتثالاً لجميع القوانين السارية فيما يتعلق باستخدام الموقع. يجب الامتثال لجميع القوانين السارية فيما يتعلق باستخدامك لموقع الأكاديمية. سياسة الخصوصية تحترم الأكاديمية العربية للعلوم و التكنولوجيا و النقل البحري خصوصية زوارموقعنا الإلكتروني (www.aast.edu) وأمن أية معلومات شخصية قد يقدموها. كما نؤمن بحق الزائر

AMAIC روابط الكليات المقرات الحياة بالأكاديمية المراكز المعاهد المجمعات العمادات تواصل معنا خريطة الموقع أخبار الأكاديمية البحرية أخبار الأكاديمية كل الأخبار لقاء رئيس الأكاديمية ووزير التعليم العالي السوداني لقاء رئيس الأكاديمية ووزير التعليم العالي السوداني نوفمبر 18, 2025 الرئيسى عام التقى سعادة الأستاذ الدكتور/ إسماعيل عبد الغفار إسماعيل فرج - رئيس الأكاديمية العربية للعلوم والتكنولوجيا والنقل البحري، ومعالي الأستاذ الدكتور/ أحمد مضاوي موسى - وزير التعليم العالي والبحث العلمي السوداني، وذلك يوم الإثنين الموافق 17- 11- 2025، بمقر الأكاديمية بمصر الجديدة. وقد عقدت فعاليات اللقاء في إطار العلاقات المتميزة والمثمرة بين الجانبين، حيث تُعد جمهورية السودان شريكًا أساسيًا في مسيرة دعم وتطوير منظومة التعليم العالي والبحث العلمي في المنطقة العربية وبصفة خاصة الأكاديمية منذ إنشائها. وخلال فعاليات اللقاء، تم استعراض مجالات التعاون الحالية، وكذلك تم بحث آفاق توسعها، بما يشمل دعم البرامج الأكاديمية والبحثية المشتركة، وتبادل الخبرات، وتطوير المبادرات العلمية التي تسهم في إعداد وتأهيل الكوادر العربية في مختلف التخصصات. كما استعرض سعادة رئيس الأكاديمية الدور الرائد للأكاديمية في دعم وتأهيل الكوادر السودانية عبر برامج البكالوريوس والدراسات العليا في مختلف فروع الأكاديمية، مشيرًا إلى أن آلاف الطلاب السودانيين تخرجوا من الأكاديمية على مدار السنوات الماضية، وأسهموا في تطوير مؤسسات السودان التعليمية والبحثية والمهنية. وتم التأكيد على الالتزام بتعزيز التعاون الأكاديمي والبحثي لدعم أهداف التنمية في السودان. وفي هذا السياق، تم عرض النموذج الرائد للتعاون الأكاديمي الذي حققته الأكاديمية بمقر الأكاديمية بمدينة العلمين، حيث نجحت كلية الطب بالأكاديمية بالتعاون مع جامعة الأحفاد السودانية في تخريج دفعة متميزة من الأطباء السودانيين الذين تم إعدادهم وفق أحدث المناهج والتقنيات العلمية والطبية، مما يعد نموذجًا يحتذى به في التعاون في مجال التعليم الطبي. وعلى هامش الزيارة لجمهورية مصر العربية ، قام معالي وزير التعليم العالي والبحث العلمي السوداني بحضور فعاليات ورشة عمل تدريبية حول "تقنيات البحث العلمي وتحليل البيانات باستخدام تطبيقات الذكاء الاصطناعي"، والتي نظمتها الأكاديمية وجامعة الدول العربية، وذلك في إطار دعم وإمداد الباحثين السودانيين بالمهارات الحيوية. كل الصور أخر الأخبار إبحث عن أخر الأخبار التسجيل بالفصل الدراسي الأول 2025 - We would like to express our gratitude to the students of CMT Alamein whose boundless participation and enthusiasm made today’s semester a great success. As we reflect on the conference today, we are reminded of the importance of keeping our minds open to new ideas and seizing opportunities for personal growth. We truly value Dr. Ahmed El Khouly’s time, expertise and commitment to supporting the next generation of leaders. As we approach the holy month of Ramadan, our students continue to show these principles by volunteering to help our hardworking staff through a special project. In honor of Ramadan and in gratitude of our university staff's efforts, students from AAST El Alamein 's management department organized and distributed necessities to our employees. This act of solidarity not only shows the students' appreciation for our staff's efforts, but also represents their desire to make a good difference in our community. Students have come together to manage the delivery of goods, to make sure our staff members are well-supported during this festive time. They have worked hard as a team to arrange scheduling, and ensure that every staff member receives the aid they require. This effort would not have been successful without the support of our whole AAST community. Faculty, staff, as well as students have united around the cause, volunteering their time, and spreading the word to assure the project's success. This support shows our university's strong sense of community and kindness. As we gather to celebrate the spirit of Ramadan, let us take a minute to acknowledge our students' selflessness and kindness. Their commitment to helping others reflects the genuine spirit of this holy month, reminding us of the value of compassion, empathy, and community. At AAST El Alamein, we are proud of our students' dedication to make a difference in the lives of others. Our students received complete examinations from qualified specialists, allowing them to gain essential knowledge into their dental health. Each student received a full report explaining any dental issues and recommended solutions, allowing them to make educated decisions regarding their dental health. Also, our students have unique access to the Faculty of Dentistry's labs, . They had access to innovative technology and techniques used in current dentistry clinics while being guided by committed lecturers. They gained useful knowledge from this practical experience . As part of this partnership, the College of Dentistry hosted a workshop on dental hygiene and care. Our students, led by specialists in the area, learnt the value of proper oral hygiene habits and received practical advice on how to maintain their dental health. The program provided our students with the knowledge and resources they needed to prioritize their oral health, including correct brushing practices and advice. This collaboration is more than just a connection between two colleges; it reflects our dedication to our students' entire growth. By including oral health education into our academic education, we hope to foster a culture of wellness and self-care among our students. We think that a healthy body and mind are necessary for academic achievement and personal satisfaction. Looking ahead, we are thrilled about how this cooperation might inspire further collaborative efforts that promote overall well-being and academic performance. Together, we can continue to look for new methods for helping our students and improve their educational experience. We deeply appreciate the Faculty of Dentistry for their collaboration and commitment to advancing oral health and education. We are building a better future for our students one smile at a time. Finance Coach is one of the most prominent companies specializing in providing training courses in the field of finance and accounting, serving more than 800 students with the support of a group of certified trainers, and it is a preparatory partner for a number of international institutions such as CFA, CISI, IMA, and AFP. The agreement was signed on behalf of the Arab Academy by Prof. Dr. Ahmed Saeed Sayed Al Rawas, Dean of the College of Management and Technology—Smart Village, and on behalf of the Finance Coach by Mr. Mohab Hamdy Al Awady, Executive Partner. Prof. Dr. Ismail Abdel Ghaffar Ismail Farag - AASTMT President, H.E. Mr. Enrico Foresto - CEO of the Italian Flyon Aero Academy, and H.E. Dr Alaa Fekry- Managing Director of the Safety Aviation Services (SAVIS), signed a tripartite cooperation agreement between AASTMT, Flyon Aero Academy, and Savis Aviation Services. The signing ceremony was held in the presence of several officials from the three participating entities. The agreement was signed within the scope of the fruitful cooperation between Savis and AASTMT, as SAVIS is a company specialized in providing Aircraft maintenance & aviation programs in Egypt, the middle east & Africa according to European Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) regulations. Additionally, the agreement is a follow-up to discussions that were held on Monday 23- 6- 2025, at AASTMT Smart Village campus, in the presence of AASTMT officials, with the goal of improving collaboration between the three entities. The agreement intends to support student training in aircraft engineering and maintenance through a new technical training program offered by Flyon Aero Academy, in addition to summer training for students, and preparation for obtaining an Aircraft Maintenance License (AML), scheduled to begin in May 2026 in Italy. Prof. Dr. Ismail Abdel Ghaffar Ismail Farag - President of the Arab Academy for Science, Technology, and Maritime Transport (AASTMT) met H.E. Prof. Dr. Ahmed Madawi Musa - Sudanese Minister of Higher Education and Scientific Research, on November 17, 2025, at AASTMT Heliopolis campus. The meeting was held as keeping on the distinguished and fruitful relations, as the Republic of Sudan is a key partner in supporting and developing higher education and scientific research in the Arab region, particularly AASTMT, since its inception. During the meeting, current areas of cooperation were reviewed, and prospects for growth were explored. This includes promoting collaborative academic and research activities, sharing knowledge, and creating scientific projects that help train and qualify Arab professionals in various disciplines. As, H.E AASTMT President emphasized AASTMT pioneering role in preparing and supporting Sudanese professionals through its undergraduate and graduate programs across AASTMT campuses. His Excellency noted that thousands of Sudanese students have graduated from AASTMT over the years and AASTMT has contributed to the development of Sudan's professional, academic, and research institutions. Both parties affirmed their commitment to enhancing research and academic collaboration in order to promote Sudan's development goals. In this context, AASTMT pioneering form of academic collaboration—achieved through its Alamein Campus was highlighted. A model for collaboration in medical education emerged at AASTMT College of Medicine, in partnership with Ahfad University of Technology in Sudan, successfully graduated a distinguished class of Sudanese doctors trained in accordance with the most recent scientific and medical curricula and technologies. His Excellency the Sudanese Minister of Higher Education and Scientific Research participated in a training workshop on "Scientific Research Techniques and Data Analysis Using Artificial Intelligence Applications" that was organized by AASTMT and the League of Arab States (LAS) to provide Sudanese researchers with essential skills, as a part of the visit to the Arab Republic of Egypt. The Arab Academy for Science, Technology and Maritime Transport participated in the inaugural meeting of the SPEEDUP project, held at the Patras Science Park in Greece. Seven partners from seven Mediterranean countries also participated in the meeting, which took place within the framework of the Interreg NEXT MED cross-border cooperation program. This program aims to promote business and entrepreneurship in the Mediterranean region. GREENOLIVE, a three-year Euro-Mediterranean project funded by the European Union through the Interreg NEXT MED Programme, starting from September 2025. The GREENOLIVE project aims to design, develop, and demonstrate an innovative 600 kW solar photovoltaic (PV) system combined with a packed-bed Thermal Energy Storage (TES) technology, targeting the supply of clean industrial heat at 300°C. Public buildings across the Mediterranean face major challenges in energy efficiency. Many of them consume large amounts of energy, resulting in higher utility costs and growing energy poverty. Buildings remain one of the biggest energy users and sources of emissions in both the EU and MENA regions, making them a critical focus for sustainable change. This inefficiency, combined with limited public awareness of energy-saving behaviors, continues to slow progress toward greater energy independence and environmental sustainability, a challenge that RESt4GREEN aims to address.
